name: Rivers
overview: Scripture reveals rivers as vital elements of God's creation, serving both practical and covenantal purposes. From the river flowing out of Eden that nourished the garden and divided into four heads, including the Euphrates, to the boundaries marked by rivers in God's promise to Abram, rivers symbolize life, provision, and divine promise. The crossing of the ford Jabbok by Jacob illustrates rivers as significant landmarks in the unfolding of God's plan for His people.
